## Scope

Issue disposition: `Closes #N` / `Relates to #N` (remaining gate: …) / `No issue` (reason: …)

## Risk class

Routine or gated (see `docs/release-policy.md`). If gated: which class, and the owner's approval phrase or "awaiting approval".

## Evidence

Exact SHA. What was run locally (typecheck, tests, build, smoke) and what was not. Mocked parts labelled mocked.

## Data and policy impact

Migrations (expand/contract), permissions, information policy, secrets, rollback.
